data.name: Aarushi
data.gender_notes: Aarushi is used as a female name in hindu naming traditions.
data.short_meaning: First ray of the sun; dawn
data.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit aruṣa, 'reddish, the dawn', from the root aruṣ, 'to shine red'. Its root is Sanskrit aruṣ (अरुष्). A classical Sanskrit term for the dawn. Aarushi is a Sanskrit name meaning “First ray of the sun; dawn”. Families who choose it generally do so for the quality the name expresses.
data.spiritual_meaning: Aarushi expresses “First ray of the sun; dawn”; spiritual readings of the name are interpretive.
data.etymology: From the Sanskrit aruṣa, 'reddish, the dawn', from the root aruṣ, 'to shine red'.
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aarushi total 32, reducing to 5. Number 5 is associated with freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
